table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	ReceiptHeader.Receiptinvcode , 
	ReceiptHeader.date , 
	ReceiptHeader.remarks , 
	ReceiptHeader.Referenceno, 
	ReceiptHeader.Referencedate, 
	username=dbo.users.username,
	posted = ReceiptHeader.posted,
	IssueInvCode=ReceiptHeader.IssueInvCode,
	recipientName=(case receiptheader.recipientcode 
							when 2 then
							 	(select name from accounts where accounts.acccode=receiptheader.acccode)
							 when 3 then
								 (select name from accounts where accounts.acccode=receiptheader.acccode)
							 when 4 then
								 (select name from salesman where salesman.salesmancode=receiptheader.recipientsalesman)
							  when 1 then
								 (select  name from department where department.deptcode=receiptheader.deptcode)
							end),
	RecipientAccountName = 	(select name from accounts where accounts.acccode=receiptheader.cracccode),
	PostedBy = IsNull((Select username from users 
		where dbo.ReceiptHeader.postedby = dbo.users.usercode), ''),
	ModifiedBy = IsNull((Select username from users 
		where dbo.ReceiptHeader.modifiedby = dbo.users.usercode), ''),
	ProdCode = (SELECT MAX(ProdHeader.ProdCode) FROM ProdHeader WHERE ProdHeader.Receiptinvcode = ReceiptHeader.Receiptinvcode),
	ProdNoteCode = (SELECT MAX(ProdNote.ProdNoteCode) FROM ProdNote WHERE ProdNote.Receiptinvcode = ReceiptHeader.Receiptinvcode),
	ReceiptCode = dbo.ReceiptHeader.ReceiptCode
FROM
	users,
	ReceiptHeader

WHERE
	( dbo.ReceiptHeader.ReceiptCategoryCode = :ai_receiptcategorycode ) AND
	( dbo.ReceiptHeader.Posted In (:as_Posted)) AND
	( dbo.ReceiptHeader.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND
	(dbo.ReceiptHeader.HeaderNo IS NULL OR 
	(dbo.ReceiptHeader.HeaderNo IN 
		(SELECT HeaderCode FROM GroupAllowedHeader 
			WHERE GroupCode = :ai_GroupCode AND Module=:ai_Module)))
